summary: Cycurion filed an 8-K disclosing Series H Convertible Preferred Stock Conversion Inducement and Exchange Agreements with Obsidian Associates (618.75 preferred shares) and M2B Funding (952.70 shares), covering accrued dividends, at a $2.70 per share exchange price subject to Nasdaq Minimum Price adjustment. Holders may exchange all Series H preferred for common stock during a limited window after the Nasdaq Listing of Additional Shares filing and public disclosure. Terms include a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker, a resale cap of 5.0% of ten-day average daily volume, Section 3(a)(9) exemption and no commissions. Watch dilution, overhang and abeyance mechanics.
